name: Google Antigravity 2.0 (Google I/O 2026)
hook: Launched May 19 at Google I/O 2026: Google's agent-first platform goes standalone with a new desktop app, CLI (Go-based, published to GitHub same day), SDK, and Managed Agents API. The multi-model roster includes Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.6 natively alongside Gemini 3.5 and GPT-OSS-120B — making it a first-class runtime for Claude-powered agents. Gemini CLI is fully retired; all users migrate here. Install via the official script; the CLI and desktop share the same agent engine so settings sync both ways.

name: Claude Code v2.1.147–148 (May 21–22)
hook: v2.1.147 (May 21) is the biggest single-release changelog in weeks: `/simplify` is gone, replaced by `/code-review [effort]` — pass `/code-review high` for thoroughness, add `--comment` to post findings directly as inline GitHub PR comments. Pinned background sessions (`Ctrl+T`) now survive idle periods and restart in place for updates. Enterprise login restrictions (`forceLoginOrgUUID`, `forceLoginMethod`) were silently not enforced against API-key sessions — now fixed. 30+ additional fixes including pasted text no longer arriving as `[Pasted text #N]` placeholders. v2.1.148 (May 22) hotfixes a Bash exit-code-127 regression from 147.

name: ccusage v20.0.3 (ryoppippi)
hook: v20.0.3 released today (May 22); 14.5k stars. Reads local usage logs from 13+ AI coding CLIs — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Amp, Droid, Hermes-Agent, Kilo, Goose, and more — and reports daily/weekly/monthly token counts and estimated costs. Zero data upload: everything stays local. JSON output, burndown projections, and per-model breakdowns. Described as "the Claude Code cost scorecard that went viral"; arguably the single most-installed companion tool in the ecosystem.

name: KPMG–Anthropic Global Alliance
hook: Announced May 19–20: all 276,000 KPMG employees globally get access to Claude via the new Digital Gateway product. The standout developer angle is KPMG Blaze — a new PE-focused portfolio offering that embeds Claude Code to modernize aging IT systems and ship AI-enabled software faster. Anthropic also named KPMG a preferred partner for private equity, with joint product development planned for portfolio companies. Follows the PwC global deployment announced earlier this month.

name: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
hook: 24.2k stars; the only Anthropic-managed, curated plugin directory for Claude Code. Ships 55+ plugins across internal (Anthropic-built) and external (partner/community) tiers. Standout built-ins: `claude-code-setup` (read-only scan of your codebase that recommends MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, and slash commands tailored to your stack), `claude-for-legal` (12 practice-area plugins, 60+ agents, 20+ MCP connectors to Westlaw/Ironclad/Everlaw), and `financial-services` plugins. Also the submission path for third-party plugins seeking official endorsement.

name: pro-workflow (rohitg00)
hook: 2.2k stars; v3.3.0 May 9. Every correction you give Claude becomes an FTS5-searchable SQLite rule that auto-loads next session — a self-correcting memory that compounds without manual CLAUDE.md maintenance. Parallel worktrees launch via `claude -w` (replaces `git worktree add` friction). Also ships LLM-powered hooks for quality gates, a persistent research wiki, compaction-aware state, and 17 battle-tested skills. Agent Teams coordinate multiple Claude Code sessions with a shared task list. Not in any prior digest.

name: CARL — Context Augmentation & Reinforcement Layer
hook: 334 stars; v2.0.0 (March 23, 2026) rewrote CARL around a unified `carl.json` + integrated MCP server. Static CLAUDE.md loads every rule on every message; CARL only loads rules that match the current task via keyword triggers — claimed 50% token reduction with better outputs because every injected rule is relevant. Global rules load unconditionally; domain rules surface on-demand. Covered by Charlie Automates as a core part of the "SEED + PAUL" production meta for Claude Code. Works on Mac, Windows, Linux.

name: AICOO-Skills (Aicoo-Team)
hook: Just launched on Product Hunt with a 5.0/5 rating. Installs as a single SKILL.md — no browser extension required — and gives your Claude Code agent a persistent network identity: agent-to-agent messaging via the Pulse Protocol, shareable public links (anyone can chat with your agent while you control permissions), autonomous heartbeat loops on a schedule, and cross-session context sync. Also connects to Aicoo Square, an AI-native discovery board where agents post. Free tier available.

name: retro-daily (gyanesh-m)
hook: A SessionStart hook that opens each Claude Code session with a personal performance dashboard: competency grades (0–100, A–F scale) across tracked skill areas, 14-day efficiency sparklines, and a year-long contributions heatmap. A background worker researches your weakest metrics using documentation and GitHub data, then surfaces concrete actions — e.g. specific settings.json adjustments — rather than vague suggestions. Turns "I want to get better at Claude Code" into measurable, transcript-grounded tasks.

name: agent-powerups (yeaight7)
hook: v0.5.0 released May 20 (1,594 commits); billed as "Oh My Zsh for coding agents." The `apx` CLI installs reusable skills into `~/.claude/skills/`, manages MCP configurations, bundles plugin assets, and provides AGENTS.md templates — all portable across Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Draws a hard boundary around shell profiles, secrets, and external tools so agent setup doesn't leak credentials. Submitted to awesome-claude-code May 20.
install: npm install -g agent-powerups && apx install claude --full
